    COUNT(DISTINCT o1.customer_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o1.customer_id), 0) AS repeat_purchase_rate
FROM
    orders o1

question: Among product categories with at least 100 reviews, which 5 have the highest negative review rate?
generated_sql:
SELECT
    ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
    COUNT(r.review_id) AS total_reviews,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_reviews,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(r.review_id), 2) AS negative_review_rate
FROM
    reviews r
JOIN
    orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN
    category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
GROUP BY
    ct.product_category_name_english
HAVING
    COUNT(r.review_id) >= 100
ORDER BY
    negative_review_rate DESC
LIMIT 5
